jobs.title: Product Manager E-Invoicing (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Warum Wir?

Bei uns erwarten Dich weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams, flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur, die zum Mitgestalten einlädt. Mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören für uns zum Alltag. Möchtest Du Teil eines innovativen Unternehmens werden, dessen Lösung den Arbeitsalltag in unterschiedlichsten Branchen digitalisiert? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams!


Das erwartet Dich

Als Product Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest Du die Anbindung von DocuWare an Netzwerke zum Austausch von e-Invoices in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, UX- und Compliance-Spezialisten. Gemeinsam stellt Ihr sicher, dass DocuWare die Anforderungen unserer Kunden an den Austausch von elektronischen Rechnungen erfüllt. Dabei behältst Du die regulatorischen Anforderungen und Zeitpläne im Blick und hilfst unseren Kunden, diese mit DocuWare zu erfüllen. 

Du kannst dich in die Lage unserer Anwenderinnen und Anwender versetzen und ihre Probleme und täglichen Aufgaben nachvollziehen? Du bist neugierig, arbeitest gerne lösungsorientiert und im Team, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und bist ein Organisationstalent? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennen zu lernen! 
Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Du verfolgst die Entwicklungen und Anforderungen für e-Invoicing in und außerhalb Europa in Zusammenarbeit mit externen und internen Compliance-Spezialisten.
  • Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Anforderungen und Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden.
  • Du agierst dabei kundenzentriert, holst Kundenfeedback ein und analysierst Daten, um die richtigen Entscheidungen abzuleiten.
  • Du formulierst präzise Anforderung zu den Kundenproblemen und -bedürfnissen.
  • Du entwirfst die kurz-, mittel- und langfristige Strategie und Roadmap für Deinen Bereich unseres Produkts und führst das Team mit Zielen und KPIs.
  • Du prägst eine konstruktive und integrative Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Produktteams und agierst als Teamschnittstelle zu Stakeholdern.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Softwareentwicklern und UX-Spezialisten an der Implementierung des Produktes im Rahmen des SCRUM-Frameworks zusammen.


Das bringst Du mit

  • Du verfügst über breites und tiefes Wissen im Bereich e-Invoicing.
  • Die Begriffe XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, FatturaPA und Factur-X sind für Dich keine Unbekannten.
  • Du kannst die Unterschiede zwischen PEPPOL, SDI, Chorus Pro und FACe in wenigen Worten verständlich erklären.
  • Du hast Erfahrung als Produktmanager für Software-Produkte. Erfahrung mit B2B Software ist ein Plus.
  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem agilen Umfeld (beispielsweise als SCRUM Product Owner).
  • Du hast Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Endnutzern und der Lösungsgestaltung anhand deren Bedürfnissen.
  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten, arbeitest zielorientiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.
  • Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich darzulegen.
  • Eine Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Teamfähigkeit zeichnen Dich aus.
  • Fließende Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.


Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

Es gibt viele gute Gründe für DocuWare – unsere Unternehmenskultur ist nur einer davon.
 Im Team von DocuWare profitierst auch Du von diesen Vorteilen:

  • Weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams: Du triffst uns in Germering, New York, Sofia oder vielen anderen Locations.
  • Flexibler Arbeitsort und Arbeitszeit: Du arbeitest mobil oder in unserem modernen und gut ausgestattetem Büro – dabei teilst Du Dir deine Arbeitszeit flexibel ein.
  • Individuelle Förderung: Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung bekommst Du regelmäßig auf Dich zugeschnittene Weiterbildungen (u.a. Kongresse, interne Teambuilding Maßnahmen).
  • Wohl verdiente Erholung: Neben 35 Urlaubstagen im Jahr bieten wir Dir ein breites Sport- und Massageangebot, Kicker-Tisch und einen entspannenden Lounge-Bereich.
  • Gesunde Ernährung: Zusammen genießen wir Fairtrade Kaffee mit Bio-Milch oder HaferDrink, Snacks und frisches Obst – alles kostenlos – sowie bezuschussten Lunch aus dem Foodji-Kühlschrank. 
  • Team-Spirit: Regelmäßige Events für Mitarbeitende - virtuell oder vor Ort sorgen für Zusammenhalt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit und soziales Engagement: DocuWare steht für papierloses Arbeiten und unterstützt ehrenamtliche Organisationen und lokale Sportvereine.
  • Gute Erreichbarkeit auf allen Wegen: Komm ins Büro mit dem geleasten E-Bike (Jobrad), per S-Bahn oder über die Autobahnen A96/A99 (Dein E-Auto kannst Du vor Ort kostenlos laden).
  • Du sorgst vor & wir unterstützen Dich dabei: DocuWare bezuschusst Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
  • Ein stabiler Arbeitsplatz: In unserem langjährig bestehenden und stetig wachsenden Unternehmen erhältst Du eine unbefristete Festanstellung.
  • Wir nutzen immer die neuesten Technologien: Erfahre mehr auf Stackshare.
  • Einzigartige Vorteile: Wähle eine von drei großartigen Optionen (Bonago, E-Gym oder Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets) nach Deinen Bedürfnissen.
  • 30 Tage Work from Abroad: Erlebe internationale Erfahrungen und erweitere Deinen Horizont.
  • Family First: Bevorzugte Anmeldung in unserer ausgewählten Kindertagesstätte in Germering (keine Garantie).
  • Buddy Programm: Du erhältst einen Buddy, der Dir den Einstieg erleichtert und Dich in Deinen ersten Wochen bei DocuWare unterstützt.
Für noch mehr Einblicke, schau doch gerne auf unserem Instagram vorbei!


Kontaktperson

Chiara Drechsel 
Team Lead Recruiting & Employer Branding

jobs.title: Product Manager, Billing Platform
Senior Program Manager, Onboarding (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Why we need you

Maltego is a tool used globally by industry experts, analysts, and law enforcement agencies to help protect and watch over their own infrastructure but also to keep guard on internet safety, reduce crime and catch bad guys.
 
The Program Manager, Onboarding owns both delivery and governance within Maltego's customer onboarding program. You manage a portfolio of complex accounts from Sales handover to Customer Success handover, and simultaneously govern the playbooks, SOPs, and continuous improvement initiatives that allow the full onboarding team to deliver quality at scale. This role combines hands-on customer engagement with program-level leadership — you run accounts, and you design the systems others work within.


What to expect

Onboarding Delivery

  • Manage a portfolio of complex, high-touch, and scale-touch accounts end-to-end, balancing delivery responsibilities with program governance work.
  • Design and execute onboarding plans for accounts with advanced technical or organizational requirements.
  • Deliver Customer Success handovers that consistently meet or exceed acceptance criteria, maintaining high CSAT across your portfolio.
  • Use insights from account work to identify patterns and inform program improvement.
Program Management
  • Design the playbooks and SOPs for Scale-touch and High-touch onboarding, maintaining accuracy and ensuring they reflect current best practice.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives: identifying inefficiencies, designing solutions, and driving rollout across the team.
  • Coordinate with Scaled and Digital Onboarding Managers to ensure program consistency across all onboarding formats.
  • Manage content accuracy as a program responsibility, working with Product to keep onboarding resources current after releases.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Build credibility with stakeholders through consistent delivery and clear communication.
  • Represent the program perspective in cross-functional meetings, contributing structured analysis and concrete recommendations.
  • Surface patterns from onboarding delivery into cross-team discussions, ensuring program feedback reaches the right people.
Customer Engagement
  • Serve as the primary customer contact for assigned accounts throughout the onboarding engagement.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Facilitate complex discovery conversations that surface strategic use cases and inform onboarding design.
  • Proactively address customer concerns before they become escalations.
Feedback, Reporting & Process Improvement
  • Synthesize feedback from accounts and program touchpoints into actionable recommendations for relevant teams.
  • Drive specific process improvement initiatives from identification through rollout, managing stakeholder alignment and change management.
  • Contribute to onboarding content and documentation improvements that scale across the full team.


Your profile in short

Required

  • Proven track record managing complex customer onboarding or implementation engagements in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.
  • Demonstrated experience owning program governance — playbooks, SOPs, or process frameworks used by other team members.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to balance multiple concurrent engagements and program initiatives.
  • Excellent communication skills — able to calibrate messaging for customers, internal stakeholders, and senior leadership.
  • Comfortable working across systems and tools (CRM, project management, analytics platforms) to track progress and report outcomes.
  • Analytical mindset — able to identify patterns, synthesize feedback, and design evidence-based improvements.
Preferred
  • Experience with OSINT, investigations, or intelligence workflows.
  • Familiarity with product-led or usage-driven customer success models.
  • Background in process improvement, change management, or operational excellence.


Why you will love Maltego

Maltego is a scale-up company. We provide you the benefits and security of larger corporations coupled with the dynamic and fast-paced work environment and flat hierarchies of a start-up. We are proud to have a large global community that loves our product because it helps to solve the investigations that are most important. 
Here are some of the reasons why you will love Maltego: 

  • Insights into the daily operations of a fast-growing tech scale-up
  • Opportunity to quickly take over responsibility and make a direct and long-lasting impact
  • Motivated and highly international team
 At Maltego, we are committed to supporting diversity and inclusion in our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of race, religion, color, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability.


Location

Our Munich office


Required documents / information

jobs.title: Senior Business Product Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
Bei Wemolo definieren wir neu, wie Menschen Parken erleben. 🅿️


Wir kombinieren smarte Infrastruktur, Daten und Software, um Barrieren in der alltäglichen Mobilität abzubauen – und machen Parken nahtlos, digital und fast unsichtbar. Als produktgetriebenes Unternehmen glauben wir an Eigenverantwortung, Wirkung und kontinuierliches Lernen: Bei uns trägst du nicht nur zu Produkten bei – du gestaltest reale Nutzererlebnisse im großen Stil.


Als Senior Business Product Manager (all genders) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für das produktseitige Fahrerlebnis und dessen strategische Weiterentwicklung. Du verknüpfst Nutzerbedürfnisse, Marktsignale und Geschäftsziele, um zu definieren, wie das Fahrerlebnis der Zukunft aussehen soll und wie es messbaren Erfolg generiert.

KI ist dein täglicher Begleiter - Du nutzt sie, um Analysen durchzuführen, Insights zu generieren und Workflows zu automatisieren, um datenbasierte Intelligenz rund um unser Produktportfolio aufzubauen.


Du hilfst uns, über das heutige Parkerlebnis hinauszugehen und den Weg zu einer smarteren, vernetzteren Mobilitätsreise einzuschlagen.

What to expect

  • Ownership: Sei der Produkt-Loop im gesamten Unternehmen: Durch die Analyse von Feedback, Bugs und Markttrends verwandelst du Nutzersignale in datenbasierte Erkenntnisse für die Produktteams. Auf unserer Roadmap balancierst du Produktqualität und Innovation. Als Pionier erschließt du neue Kundensegmente für eine nutzerzentrierte Entwicklung.

  • Strategie & Markt: Behalte alles im Blick – von Wettbewerbsbewegungen und strategischen Analysen bis hin zu neuen Branchentrends, neuen Produktbereichen, Kundenwünschen und den Bedürfnissen der Parkplatznutzer.

  • Discovery & Validation: Arbeite eng mit Kunden und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um Chancen zu validieren, wiederkehrende Muster zu identifizieren und die Marktnachfrage in eine klare, langfristige Produktstrategie zu übersetzen. Du bringst Erfahrung aus allen Phasen des Produktlebenszyklus mit und fokussierst dich auf die frühe Discovery-Phase, um Projekte so effektiv wie möglich zu bewerten.

  • Overview: Übernimm die Produktverantwortung für große, bereichsübergreifende Projekte und sorge als Programme Manager dafür, dass diese erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

  • Kollaboration: Arbeite eng mit den jeweiligen Produkt- und Entwicklerteams - ohne dein eigenes Entwicklerteam zu haben - sowie den Bereichen Commercial, Operations und dem Management zusammen, um Produktentscheidungen mit den Geschäftszielen zu verknüpfen. Deine Mission ist es, die Realität des Rollouts mit den Kundenbedürfnissen in Einklang zu bringen.

Inspire us by

  • Hintergrund: Du hast mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement im Bereich B2B-Software, SaaS, Plattformen oder ähnlich komplexen Umgebungen, einschließlich fundierter praktischer Erfahrung im Aufbau und der Entwicklung von Produkten in frühen Phasen.

  • Produkt- & Marktverständnis: Du verstehst Kundenprobleme, Marktdynamiken sowie Wettbewerbslandschaften und kannst diese Erkenntnisse nutzen, um die Produktstrategie und -positionierung zu prägen.

  • Kommerzielles Denken: Du bist in der Lage, Produktentscheidungen mit dem Kundennutzen, der Skalierbarkeit und den Geschäftsergebnissen zu verknüpfen, und arbeitest eng mit den kommerziellen Teams zusammen, ohne Produkte isoliert vom Markt zu betrachten.

  • Technisches Verständnis und Perspektive: Du hast einen technischen Hintergrund oder Erfahrung mit Tech-Projekten. Du kannst Projekte sowohl aus der Perspektive von Engineers als auch aus der von weniger technikaffinen Kollegen diskutieren und Lösungen erarbeiten.

  • Stakeholder-Management: Du kannst eine Vielzahl von Stakeholdern auf ein gemeinsames Ziel ausrichten und dabei den Fokus auf das Produkt beibehalten.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und fließend Englisch, da die Rolle gelegentlichen Kundenkontakt mit Fokus auf die DACH-Region beinhaltet.

What we offer

  • Flexibilität & Eigenverantwortung: Dein Arbeitsalltag, deine Performance - Unser hybrides Modell ermöglicht dir fokussiertes arbeiten im Homeoffice, frische Perspektiven in der Workation sowie persönlichen Austausch an unseren Anchor-Days (Dienstag bis Donnerstag)

  • Mobilität nach Maß: Volle Fahrt voraus - Ob nachhaltig mit Bike-Leasing oder bequem mit Fahrtkostenzuschuss, wir halten dich mobil und flexibel auf Kurs

  • KI im Alltag: KI ist bei uns kein Buzzword, sondern Teil deines Workflows – für bessere Insights, schnellere Lösungen und weniger repetitive Aufgaben.

  • Ownership & Gestaltungsspielraum: Dein Impact, deine Bilanz - Übernimm volle Ownership für deinen Bereich und deine KPIs

  • Teamkultur & Networking: Echte Verbindungen – auch abseits vom Daily Business. Feiere Erfolge mit uns bei legendären Teamevents und Spirit Days

  • Produktive Umgebung: Brainfood Deluxe - Ob Siebträger-Kaffee, Bella&Bona Online-Kantine, frisches Obst oder Müsli Bar. Dein Wohlbefinden ist die Basis für starke Performance

  • Gesundheit & Ausgleich: Bleib in Balance mit EGYM Wellpass oder Urban Sports Club - deutschlandweit Zugang zu 1.000+ Sport- und Gesundheitseinrichtungen

  • Top-Equipment & Ergonomie: Ob Mac oder Windows, im Office oder Homeoffice - Deine Effizienz und dein Arbeitskomfort kommen nicht zu kurz

  • Dresscode? Dein Code: Bei uns zählt, was du bewegst – nicht, was du trägst. Zieh an, worin du dich am wohlsten fühlst

 

Innovation through diversity

Unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund, deiner Herkunft, deiner Geschlechtsidentität oder deinen individuellen Voraussetzungen ist es deine Persönlichkeit, die uns interessiert. Deshalb schaffen wir eine Kultur des Miteinanders und des Respekts, in der jedes Teammitglied ein Mitspracherecht hat, sich persönlich weiterentwickeln kann und wertgeschätzt fühlt.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Agents
jobs.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’ collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

At Superhuman, we're not just another tech company. We help people communicate better with the world around them in their everyday lives. Whether it's a student writing their first essay in English, someone navigating a new country, or professionals trying to convey their ideas clearly, our work genuinely enhances how people connect and express themselves. To build on our success and reach even more users worldwide, we are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Agents team.

You will play a critical role in leading and executing our company’s strategy to launch new categories of AI agents, expanding Superhuman’s reach beyond writing into richer productivity workflows.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop the product strategy and roadmap for new agent categories that power new productivity workflows.

  • Create intuitive agentic experiences: make powerful LLM capabilities feel approachable, simple, and useful.

  • Turn ambiguity into clarity: define problem spaces, craft hypotheses, set success metrics, and drive zero-to-one bets from idea to scale.

  • Build data-informed learning loops: create evaluation frameworks, run experiments, and turn insights into clear product decisions.

  • Collaborate across disciplines and geographies: partner with engineers, product designers, data scientists, marketers, and user researchers to ship and iterate at high velocity.

Qualifications

  • Has at least 5 years of experience with Product Management

  • Has a genuine interest in AI technology. You have professional experience building AI/ML products, and/or you are actively experimenting with AI in personal projects.

  • Outstanding product and design sense, with a track record of shipping consumer products that people love at scale.

  • Can drive learning, execution, and impact in a product area with ambiguity.

  • Has a solid understanding of how to define success, set, and move critical metrics.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first, hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our team member resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations—to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.

For more details about the personal data Superhuman collects during the recruitment process, for what purposes, and how you can address your rights, please see the Superhuman Data Privacy Notice for Candidates here.

Compensation: €110K – €150K

jobs.title: Senior Construction Project Manager
jobs.description:
Elgin Values

Core behavioural responsibilities for all employees
 
Agility We Lead with Agility  Integrity We Act with IntegrityExcellence We Empower ExcellenceCareWe Value Care


Job Description

Are you an experienced construction project leader with the commercial acumen to deliver complex infrastructure projects while managing the expectations of lenders, investors and key stakeholders?

We are looking for an experienced Senior Construction Project Manager to fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role across Elgin’s utility-scale solar PV, BESS and co-located PV/BESS projects. The role is focused on leading multidisciplinary project teams within a single Elgin delivery framework, ensuring that finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations, route-to-market and external adviser inputs are coordinated into one clear project position from late stage development / FID through construction, commissioning, commercial operations and handover to Asset Management. Particular emphasis will be placed on lender, investor, SPV governance and internal delivery interfaces.
 
This role requires significant project and contract management experience, including direct involvement in project finance processes, lender due diligence, conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender reporting, waivers / consents and coordination with lender technical advisers. The successful candidate will need specific experience with FIDIC based Construction Contracts, strong commercial judgement, disciplined contract administration capability and the ability to translate project delivery status into clear funding, governance and decision-making outputs.
 
To be successful in the role, you will have experience representing a client, employer, sponsor or SPV in the delivery of complex infrastructure or renewable energy projects. You will be commercially astute, highly organised, confident leading multidisciplinary project teams through a common governance and delivery framework, and capable of engaging credibly with lenders, investors, advisers, contractors, shareholder forums and senior internal stakeholders.

What you will be do:

  • Fulfil the Client / Employer’s Representative role for allocated projects, ensuring Elgin’s SPV, governance, commercial and contractual obligations are actively managed from FID through COD and handover.
  • Lead project and contract management on project-financed assets, coordinating lender processes including conditions precedent, drawdown evidence, lender technical adviser queries, lender reporting, waivers / consents and funding milestone submissions.
  • Administer and manage high-value EPC, ICP and related project contracts, including notices, variations, claims, payment applications, completion milestones, liquidated damages, defects and close-out obligations.
  • Maintain disciplined project controls across programme, budget, cash flow, risk, actions, decisions and change, ensuring transparent reporting to senior management, SPV governance bodies, lenders and investors.
  • Act as the primary project coordination point between Elgin’s internal project team, finance, legal, procurement, engineering, construction, operations, route-to-market and external advisers, ensuring that all workstreams operate from one integrated delivery plan, one risk position and one set of decision requirements.
  • Lead and manage multidisciplinary internal project teams within Elgin’s agreed delivery framework by setting priorities, clarifying accountabilities, managing dependencies, aligning workstreams to project milestones and escalating decisions in a timely and structured manner.
  • Manage the relationship and reporting cadence with project finance lenders, equity investors, shareholder representatives, lender technical advisers and other key finance-facing stakeholders, including preparing and presenting clear, decision-ready updates for shareholder forums and related governance meetings.
  • Oversee contractor, owner’s engineer and technical adviser interfaces to ensure delivery evidence, technical outputs and contractual positions support Elgin’s funding, governance and employer obligations.
  • Proactively identify commercial, contractual, programme and financing risks, develop mitigation plans and ensure issues are escalated with clear options, recommendations and decision requirements.
  • Support tendering, contract negotiation and commercial strategy by ensuring delivery arrangements are bankable, financeable, contractually robust and aligned with lender / investor expectations.


Your profile

What you will need: 

  • Degree in project management, construction management, engineering, or similar.
  • Extensive experience in infrastructure, renewables, power, energy storage or comparable capital projects, with significant project and contract management responsibility.
  • Direct experience working on project-financed projects, including lender due diligence, , funding drawdowns, lender technical adviser processes and ongoing lender / investor reporting.
  • Strong understanding of the Client / Employer’s Representative role and experience representing an owner, SPV, sponsor or employer in the delivery of complex contracted projects.
  • Extensive experience administering FIDIC, EPC, ICP and construction management contracts, including notices, variations, claims, payment mechanisms, completion tests, liquidated damages and contractual close-out.
  • Demonstrable ability to lead multidisciplinary internal teams and align finance, legal, engineering, procurement, construction, operations and external adviser inputs around delivery milestones within a standardised delivery framework.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to assess risk versus reward, protect the employer’s position and communicate implications clearly to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience preparing and presenting concise, decision-ready reports for senior management, investment committees, SPV boards, lenders, investors, shareholder forums and other governance forums, with the ability to translate complex programme, commercial, technical and financing issues into clear options and recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of utility-scale solar PV, BESS, grid connection and route-to-market interfaces, with sufficient technical understanding to challenge contractors and advisers effectively.
  • Highly organised and proficient in Microsoft Office and project controls tools, with strong written communication, meeting management and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Valid driver’s license for Ireland and the UK.

jobs.title: Product Manager – POS & Fiscalization (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
A Swissbit more you.

Swissbit ist der führende europäische Hersteller von Speicher- und Security-Lösungen für Industrie- und IoT-Anwendungen.
Wir machen die digitale Welt sicherer, indem wir Daten zuverlässig speichern und schützen. Dafür suchen wir Kolleg:innen, die gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft gestalten wollen.
Du willst mitgestalten, statt nur zu verwalten? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.


Deine Mission

Als Product Manager (m/f/d) im Bereich POS & Fiscalization übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unseres Geschäfts mit Lösungen für Kassensysteme, TSE und fiskalische Anforderungen.
Du verbindest technisches Verständnis mit ausgeprägtem Geschäftssinn und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden, Partnern und internen Teams passgenaue Lösungen – von der ersten Geschäftsidee über die technische Integration bis zum erfolgreichen Rollout.
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit POS-Herstellern, Softwareanbietern, Resellern, Payment Providern und strategischen Kunden im deutschen und europäischen Markt zusammen.


Spannende Aufgaben warten auf Dich

  • Business Development & Kundenentwicklung: Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Beziehungen zu POS-Herstellern, Softwareanbietern, Resellern, Payment Providern und strategischen Kunden.
  • Opportunity Management: Begleitung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten von der ersten Kundenansprache über technische Evaluation und TSE-/POS-Integration bis hin zu kommerziellen Verhandlungen und Rollout
  • Technische Kundenberatung: Unterstützung unserer Kunden bei TSE-Implementierungen, fiskalischen Anforderungen, POS-Architekturen und Integrationskonzepten
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product Management, Engineering und weiteren internen Teams bei technischen Evaluierungen und Kundenprojekten
  • Customer Solutions: Entwicklung kundenspezifischer Lösungen sowie Erstellung von Account-Plänen und Business Cases
  • Projektbegleitung: Steuerung komplexer Kundenprojekte und Sicherstellung einer erfolgreichen Umsetzung gemeinsam mit Kunden und technischen Partnern
  • Commercial Responsibility: Verantwortung für vereinbarte Umsatz- und Profitabilitätsziele sowie Unterstützung bei Pricing und kommerziellen Verhandlungen
  • Market Development: Beobachtung des deutschen und europäischen POS- und Fiscalization-Marktes sowie Identifikation neuer Markt- und Geschäftspotenziale


Dein Profil

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung: Erfahrung in den Bereichen POS, Retail Technology, Payment, Fiscalization oder vergleichbaren technischen B2B-Lösungen
  • Fiscalization Expertise: Fundierte praktische Kenntnisse des deutschen Fiskalisierungsmarktes, insbesondere im Bereich TSE, POS-Integration und steuerliche Compliance-Anforderungen
  • TSE-Erfahrung: Nachweisbare Erfahrung bei der Implementierung oder Betreuung von TSE- und Fiskallösungen innerhalb von POS-Umgebungen
  • Technisches Verständnis: Gute Kenntnisse von POS-Architekturen, APIs, Cloud-Services und Hardware-Integrationen
  • Branchen-Netzwerk: Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit POS-Herstellern, Softwareanbietern, Resellern oder Systemintegratoren. Ein bestehendes Netzwerk im deutschen und europäischen POS- und Fiscalization-Markt ist ein großer Vorteil
  • B2B-Erfahrung: Erfolgreicher Track Record in Business Development, Development oder Projektmanagement von technisch anspruchsvollen B2B-Lösungen
  • Schnittstellenkompetenz: Du kannst technische Integrations- und Implementierungsthemen mit Entwicklern und Architekten diskutieren und gleichzeitig Business Cases mit Senior Management und Kunden verhandeln
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du arbeitest eigenständig, pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert und fühlst dich wohl in komplexen Kunden- und Projektumgebungen
  • Kommunikation: Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsstärke
  • Sprachen: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Reisebereitschaft: Bereitschaft zu Reisen von bis zu 50 %


Was wir Dir bieten

  • Sorgfältige Einarbeitung in ein motiviertes Team mit einem angenehmen Arbeitsklima & offener Kommunikationskultur
  • Ein internationales, innovationsgetriebenes Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Optionen und Open-Desk-Policy
  • Standortwahl frei: München, Konstanz, Berlin oder hybrid
  • Familienfreundliche Unternehmenskultur und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

jobs.title: Group Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Einleitung

Bei Peter Park ist "Product" nicht einfach nur ein Unternehmensbereich. Hier trifft alles aufeinander: Wohin wir als Unternehmen wollen, was wir verkaufen, wie wir wachsen, was unsere Kunden erleben. Als Group Product Manager verantwortest du eine Product Area im Produktmanagement, führst ein Team von Product Managern und arbeitest täglich mit einem breiten Stakeholder-Feld zusammen. Wenn du wirklich gestalten und führen willst, ist das die richtige Stelle.


Was ist Deine Aufgabe?

  • People Leadership, Coaching & Culture: Du hast die volle disziplinarische Verantwortung für ein Team von 2–3 Product Managern und prägst die Teamkultur mit dem Ziel, wachsende Eigenverantwortung und Empowerment im Team zu entwickeln.
  • Produktstrategie & Alignment: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die Strategie für deine Product Area und stellst das kontinuierliche Alignment mit unseren Unternehmenszielen sicher. Du managst den Produktlebenszyklus und pflegst den Product Governance Prozess – schnell liefern, ohne Qualität zu opfern.
  • Business Impact & Markt: Du steuerst Ressourcen für maximalen Impact und bewertest und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Kundenzufriedenheit auf Area-Ebene. Dafür hast du Markttrends und den Wettbewerb stets im Blick.
  • Stakeholder-Management: Du hältst für deine Product Area die Fäden zusammen und hast stets das große Ganze im Blick. Dabei kommunizierst du sicher mit unterschiedlichen Unternehmensbereichen und Managementebenen.


Deine Fähigkeiten:

  • Du bringst 7+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung als Senior PM, Lead PM oder Team Lead im Product Management mit – idealerweise in einem schnellwachsenden Start-up, Scale-up, SaaS- oder IoT-Umfeld.
  • Du hast über 1,5 Jahre Erfahrung in der disziplinarischen Führung.
  • Du hast eigenständig eine Produktstrategie auf Area-Ebene entwickelt und verantwortet – inkl. Roadmap-Planung.
  • Du arbeitest sicher mit agilen Methoden und bist vertraut mit Outcome-Metriken und datenbasierter Entscheidungsfindung.
  • Du verfügst über exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und eine ausgeprägte Fähigkeit zur internen Kollaboration.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, übernimmst Ownership für komplexe Themen und verlierst dabei nie das große Ganze aus dem Blick.
  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse.


Work Setup:

  • 40 Stunden pro Woche (Vertrauensbasis)
  • Homeoffice Policy: 3 Tage im Office / 2 Tage remote
  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
  • Arbeitsort: München
  • Team: 6 Kolleg:innen


Welche Vorteile bietet mir Peter Park?

So sieht Dein Arbeitsalltag bei uns aus

  • Arbeiten mit Bergblick: Unser Büro in der Neuen Balan bietet mehr als nur moderne Ausstattung: Von der Dachterrasse aus genießt Du ein Alpenpanorama, im Sommer wird gemeinsam gegrillt, und unsere Teamevents sorgen für gute Stimmung.
  • Teamgeist und Impact-Kultur: Bei uns zählt Deine Stimme! Wir leben flache Hierarchien und eine Kultur des "Du" vom ersten Tag an. Das bedeutet: kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Austausch mit allen Ebenen und ein Team, das Dich aktiv unterstützt. Deine Ideen sind hier nicht nur willkommen, sondern werden gehört.
  • Freiraum für Deine Ideen: Du übernimmst Verantwortung und kannst Deine Ideen aktiv einbringen. Wir fördern Deine Entwicklung – mit echtem Vertrauen in Deine Fähigkeiten.
Das bieten wir Dir zusätzlich
  • Dein Plus: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Corporate Benefits und Jobrad-Leasing – und on top wählst du selbst zwischen einem bezuschussten Deutschlandticket oder EGYM Wellpass
  • Deine Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zur EU-Workation
  • Dein Setup: Ein Onboarding, das dich direkt abholt, höhenverstellbare Tische und modernes Apple Equipment für deinen perfekten Start ab Tag eins
  • Dein Wohlbefinden: Ein gesunder Energiekick durch kostenlose Snacks (Obst, Nüsse, Müsli), bezuschusstes Office-Catering und der wöchentliche Team-Lunch
  • Dein Match: Gelebte Start-up-Mentalität in einem finanziell sicheren und stabilen Umfeld

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Das sind wir

Seit 2000 macht die ITA Logistics Group den Versand für Unternehmen einfacher, transparenter und effizienter. Mit unseren Plattformen LetMeShip und ParcelParcel können Unternehmen ihren täglichen Versand schnell vergleichen und direkt buchen. Dabei bündeln wir zahlreiche Versanddienstleister auf unseren Plattformen und kombinieren moderne Technologie mit persönlichem Service.


An mehreren Standorten in Europa arbeiten unsere Teams täglich daran, Versandprozesse nachhaltig zu vereinfachen. Wir setzen auf offene Zusammenarbeit sowie kurze Entscheidungswege und suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Ideen einbringen und aktiv mitgestalten möchten.


Deine Rolle

Als (Technical) Product Owner (m/w/d) bist du Teil unseres Product Teams und übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale technische Schnittstellen und Integrationen unserer Plattformen. Dein Fokus liegt insbesondere auf unseren Customer APIs, der Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) sowie perspektivisch der Unified Financial Platform (UFP) und unserer HubSpot-Integration.

Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Product, Engineering und Business. Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge, übersetzt unterschiedliche Anforderungen in klare Prioritäten und sorgst gemeinsam mit unseren Teams dafür, dass unsere Integrationen zuverlässig funktionieren und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.

Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Product Ownern, unserem Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers und Data Insights zusammen und bist gleichzeitig wichtige Ansprechperson für interne Stakeholder, Kunden, Carrier und externe Partner.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Roadmap unserer Customer APIs für LMS Enterprise und LMS Next und entwickelst diese strategisch weiter.

  • Du treibst die Migration unserer API-Kunden von LMS Enterprise zu LMS Next voran und identifizierst, welche Features und Carrier-Integrationen dafür benötigt werden.

  • Du bist technische Ansprechperson für unsere API-Kunden und unterstützt bei Fragen sowie bei der Analyse und Lösung von Problemen.

  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit internen und externen Stakeholdern die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unified Carrier Interface (UCI).

  • Du analysierst Anforderungen an Carrier-Features und Services, bereitest diese für unser Engineering auf und unterstützt QA bei der Definition relevanter Test Cases.

  • Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Carriern und klärst technische Anforderungen und Besonderheiten rund um deren Integrationen.

  • Nach dem Go-live übernimmst du die Verantwortung für unsere Unified Financial Platform (UFP) und steuerst deren Backlog und Weiterentwicklung.

  • Du behältst unsere bestehende HubSpot-Integration im Blick und priorisierst Anpassungen entsprechend neuer Business-Anforderungen und Feedbacks.

  • Über alle Themen hinweg bringst du Engineering, Business Stakeholder, Carrier und externe Partner zusammen und sorgst für klare Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du verfügst über einen technischen Hintergrund, beispielsweise in Software Engineering oder Informatik, oder hast bereits mehrere Jahre an der Schnittstelle zwischen Product und Engineering gearbeitet.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager mit – idealerweise im Umfeld von APIs, Plattformen oder technischen Integrationen.

  • Du hast ein gutes Verständnis von APIs, API Design, Versionierung und Migrationsstrategien und kannst technische Diskussionen mit unseren Engineers auf Augenhöhe führen.

  • Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verstehen und sie für unterschiedliche Stakeholder verständlich übersetzen.

  • Du bist sicher im Stakeholder Management und kannst unterschiedliche technische und wirtschaftliche Anforderungen gegeneinander abwägen und priorisieren.

  • Mehrere parallele Workstreams und wechselnde Prioritäten bringen dich nicht aus dem Konzept – du behältst den Überblick und setzt klare Schwerpunkte.

  • Du arbeitest gerne kollaborativ und standortübergreifend mit Kollegen in Hamburg und Naarden zusammen.

  • Du interessierst dich für AI Tools und digitale Lösungen und probierst gerne neue Wege aus, um Prozesse und Workflows effizienter zu gestalten.

  • Erfahrung in Logistik, Parcel oder Freight Tech, insbesondere mit Carrier-API-Integrationen, ist ein Plus.

  • Kenntnisse rund um HubSpot bzw. CRM-Integrationen oder Finanz- und Invoicing-Systeme sind ebenfalls von Vorteil.


Warum ITA Logistics Group?

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem neue Ideen ausdrücklich willkommen sind und Feedback nicht nur erlaubt, sondern erwünscht ist. Wir hinterfragen Bestehendes, arbeiten agil und entwickeln uns kontinuierlich weiter. Dazu gehört für uns auch der Einsatz moderner digitaler Tools und KI-Anwendungen, die deinen Arbeitsalltag sinnvoll unterstützen und Prozesse effizienter machen.

jobs.title: Member of Marketing Staff - Marketing Producer FTC
jobs.description:
Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup based in London, founded by Guy Podjarny. We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Index Ventures, Accel, GV, and Boldstart, and in 2025 we were ranked #2 in Sifted EU’s B2B SaaS Rising 100 and #20 in Sifted's AI 100.

At Tessl, we are building the context layer for AI coding agents, and a platform for AI-native software development. As an early member of the team, you’ll help shape how we build, scale and support a company operating at the edge of AI and software development.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Content ships fast across engineering, marketing, community, and DevRel. This role is the connective tissue that makes that possible: owning the comms calendar, publishing content, coordinating creative assets and social comms, moderating comments in channels like YouTube, and making sure content reaches the channels and communities where our audience is. This is a 6-month fixed-term contract (FTC).

This is an execution and coordination role, and a great entry point into B2B marketing at an AI-native company. It also includes building automations for this work using Tessl's own Dark Factory, with support from our GTM engineer, so repeatable production tasks get systemized rather than repeated by hand.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Content calendar & publishing workflow

  • Own the content calendar end to end and keep it current after every planning meeting

  • Coordinate the publishing pipeline: chase drafts, request design assets with adequate lead time, and hold authors accountable to deadlines

Publishing & distribution

  • Own the social media calendar and publish posts (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Reddit, Discord) using pre-generated copy and UTM links.

  • Publish videos to YouTube with pre-written descriptions and links; manage thumbnails and playlist placement.

  • Cross-post published content to branded third-party channels (Reddit, Hacker Noon, Dev.to) with canonical backlinks and UTM tracking, following the existing UTM taxonomy.

  • Build and maintain an automation that surfaces relevant developer community threads (Reddit, Hacker News) and drafts contextual posts back to published content, pushing them to Slack in real time so DevRel and community-trusted individuals can review and post under their own name, this role builds the surfacing and drafting mechanism.

  • Produce a monthly developer-community signal report (notable threads, questions, sentiment) for DevRel, Product, Marketing, and Sales, which will become an automated workflow feeding the same real-time Slack surfacing above.

Moderation & community response

  • Respond to comments and questions on social and YouTube (triage or use internal tooling)

  • Moderate comments across channels: remove spam/abuse, flag anything sensitive or reputationally risky before responding (auto-hide is enabled for malicious comments)

  • Pull noteworthy comments, questions, and feedback into Slack weekly, so the team sees what the audience is saying without reading every thread themselves

Cross-team production support

  • Pick up ad hoc marketing production requests (design briefs, YouTube channel merchandising, banner requests) so they don't fall to senior team members

  • Flag blockers and surface feedback across content, growth, and product marketing to keep the team aligned

Workflow automation

  • Identify manual, repeatable tasks in the production pipeline and build lightweight automations or Claude skills for them

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

  • Publishing runs on schedule with few follow-ups needed

  • Authors and stakeholders get consistent, visible accountability through one shared channel

  • Distribution reach (impressions, upvotes, referred traffic) grows month over month against a shared baseline

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must have:

  • Strong written English and good judgment on public tone, since comment moderation and response require calling the right register in public

  • Comfortable working across functions without a fixed lane; this role touches content and growth in the same week

  • Comfortable navigating LinkedIn, X, Reddit, and YouTube Studio day to day

  • Has used AI and can demonstrate a workflow or application you’ve built

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with Reddit/Hacker News community norms

  • Basic Notion/Linear fluency

  • Some comfort with no-code or lightweight scripting for internal tooling

No marketing strategy experience required, this is an entry-level role, well suited to an early-career marketer, a career switcher, or someone returning to work after a break.

SALARY AND BENEFITS

Office: Our brand new 10,000 sq. ft office is in the AI hub of Kings Cross, London. We have generous catering and regular social events such as team lunches, drinks, and more. We require all staff to be in our London HQ at least 3 days a week on our anchor days of Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.

Salary: We offer a competitive salary based on experience and skills, benchmarked against industry standards and appropriate for an entry-level/apprenticeship position.

Benefits: 25 days holiday, health insurance including dental and vision (extends to partners and dependents), and a company-matched pension. We also provide a commuting stipend for those who live outside London, and a Cycle to Work scheme.

APPLICATION PROCESS

  1. Introductory call

  2. Hiring manager deep dive

  3. Practical exercise (content/publishing task)

  4. Final conversation with the marketing team

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement. We care about talent, trajectory, and mindset, not just checkboxes.


We care deeply about the warm, inclusive environment we’re building at Tessl and we value diversity – we welcome applications from those typically underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this role but are not totally sure whether you’re the right person, do apply anyway!

This is a generalist role. The patterns for how developers work with AI agents are still forming, and you'll have a direct hand in shaping them across the product — from the CLI and core platform to the new bets we'll place as we expand. Much of the work is 0-to-1: you'll shape product direction amid genuine ambiguity, translate fast-moving model and research breakthroughs into experiences developers trust, and decide what's worth building when there's no settled playbook.

The stack is optimized for deep learning and heavy data throughput: PyTorch and [Ray/Hugging Face] for training and fine-tuning foundation models, Trino and Athena for querying massive user-behavior data lakes, and dedicated GPU infrastructure for heavy workloads. About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

9fin is already the leading platform for legal intelligence in debt capital markets. Our proprietary AI capabilities extract and analyse legal language at scale, and our unique dataset of credit legal documentation delivers intelligence that generic AI tools simply cannot match.

Now we are investing to extend that leadership. You will lead a dedicated engineering team to define the next chapter of 9fin's legal product — going deeper on AI, building richer workflows, and expanding into the law firm segment, where we see a significant TAM opportunity that is ours to capture.

Your users sit at the centre of the debt markets ecosystem: origination teams at top investment banks, lawyers at leading law firms, and credit analysts at hedge funds and credit funds.

This is a great opportunity to shape the future of a product and a company that's using technology to revolutionise the trillion-dollar debt capital market.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Product Strategy & Execution

  • Strategy: Define and champion the product vision and strategy for the Covenants squad from the ground up, working closely with engineering, our legal analysts, and key customers to establish what to build and why.

  • Problem definition & structured thinking: Synthesise insights from in-house legal subject matter experts (SMEs), customer interviews, customer feedback and data signals to craft a clear problem statement, articulating the root cause in a structured way.

  • Discovery: Use a range of techniques to identify and understand what users need and their workflows, across a sophisticated professional audience spanning credit analysts, portfolio managers, restructuring advisors, and law firms.

  • Impact driven: Align the team around a key outcome and effectively prioritise initiatives across multiple dimensions.

  • Measuring success: Proactively identify and track metrics to measure client and business benefit. Work with the team to define and manage a process for continuous model evaluation and improvement, with particular attention to the accuracy and reliability standards required in legal contexts.

Team Leadership & Communication

  • Team success: Create a collaborative environment for your squad, providing wider context and clear goals so everyone can do their best work.

  • Communication: Ensure all people involved are aware of the team's strategy, initiatives, and progress. You must be able to effectively communicate complex legal and financial concepts to technical audiences, and similarly communicate technical capabilities to legal and credit professionals.

  • Influence: Build strong relationships to empower the squad to achieve the desired outcome, often by influencing stakeholders outside of your team.

  • Stakeholder management: Work closely with stakeholders, including 9fin's legal analysts, credit team to gather the right input and insights. You will need to listen carefully and bring people on a journey.

AI Product Development

  • Own the roadmap for AI-powered legal document extraction and covenant analysis, ensuring outputs meet the precision standards required for professional use.

  • Partner with software and AI engineering to define evaluation frameworks for AI outputs in legal contexts, where accuracy, source attribution, and explainability are critical to user trust.

  • Identify opportunities to apply emerging AI capabilities to novel legal workflow problems, from covenant compliance monitoring to cross-document analysis across deal histories.

About You

This role will be a great fit if:

  • You have a legal or financial markets background, or have built products for this audience. You may have started your career as a lawyer, paralegal, or credit analyst, or you may have been a PM at a legal tech company. You are able to hold a substantive conversation about credit agreements, covenant packages, and how legal language governs capital structures. A sharp PM from an adjacent domain who can demonstrate rapid domain immersion will also be considered.

  • You are a strategic thinker who thrives with a blank page. You are comfortable defining strategy from scratch, not just executing an existing roadmap. You can synthesise ambiguous inputs into a clear direction and bring a team with you.

  • You're a collaborative leader. You have an empathetic leadership style and build strong, effective relationships. You love working autonomously but are able to earn the trust of others with a collaborative style. You are great at prioritising, not afraid to say no, and excel at managing stakeholders while also being confident in voicing your own opinions and challenging others.

  • You've got hands-on experience with AI. You have experience with or a working knowledge of AI and LLMs, including how to evaluate model outputs in production environments. You understand what good looks like when AI is applied to high-stakes, precision-dependent workflows, and you can engage meaningfully with engineering teams on evaluation design and quality standards.

  • You work in an AI-native way. You use generative AI tools as a natural part of how you work: prototyping ideas, conducting research, reviewing PRDs, and building agents or automated workflows to extend your own productivity. You are comfortable using coding assistants to get things done faster and are genuinely excited about what this shift means for how product work gets done. This is not a nice-to-have. We expect our PMs to be at the frontier of how AI accelerates product development.

  • You thrive building from zero. You are energised by the opportunity to define something new rather than optimise something established. You move quickly, make decisions with incomplete information, and course-correct based on evidence.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Product development in MedTech is highly complex: teams need to manage requirements, documentation, quality processes, regulatory expectations, and internal reviews across many systems and stakeholders. We work with some of the world’s leading life sciences and MedTech companies, including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun, and Novartis. We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Deine Position

The average day of a Senior IT Operations Specialist
The role is divided into 3 key value areas: 

  1. Tech Support on level 1, 2 and 3 tickets created by holding employees. The goal here is to be familiar with stakeholders for faster, more efficient turnaround. Tickets are not escalated, but are triaged and discussed to improve technical understanding and develop. You will also monitor queues for the other markets for urgent out of hours requests, and action them when necessary. Level 1 and 2 tickets may be delegated to working students in the team, with guidance and accountability.
  2. Tech Projects - This refers to projects imposed by Employee Technology Platform product strategy such as rollout of Chrome OS and tool consolidations for the holding. This also refers to inbound projects imposed by holding teams (e.g. tailor onboarding experience, upgrading office infrastructure etc).
  3. Tech Consulting - Providing solutions using existing tools first, through enablement sessions. If no solutions exist, working with teams to technically own and benchmark new applications. There is a particular push to enable AI usage to boost productivity. This means any queries on how to use basic or advanced AI toolings would be directed to this role.


Dein Profil

  • Minimum of 4+ years of proven professional experience in IT systems, systems engineering or a related field.
  • Experience with IT support ticketing best practices, and analysis.
  • Proven ability to work both independently, and as part of a team on Technology related projects.
  • Profound knowledge of Google Workspace, Office 365, Mobile Device Management (JAMF and InTune) and other SaaS applications surrounding employee productivity, collaboration and security.
  • Profound knowledge of AI tooling, specifically relating to employee productivity.
  • Understanding on how to utilize scripting to build bespoke functions. Experience with web-front end HTML, CSS, AppScript, Typescript and Cursor AI
  • Understanding of the workings of cloud infrastructure and code deployment practices and discipline is a huge plus.
  • Generalist knowledge of office infrastructure (e.g. office WLAN, meeting room hardware incl neat).
  • Comprehensive knowledge and proven disciplinary action of domain management
  • Great people skills, being able to persuade and consult non-technical stakeholders on technical solutions.
  • Ability to demonstrate design thinking methodology.
  • Ability to collaborate in a fast-paced, agile environment and adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a security focus.
  • Relevant IT Bachelors or Masters degree. Certifications related to MTD, MAM are a plus!
  • German and English written and verbal communication
  • Willingness to travel, with the most common location being Berlin.


Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues
  • You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers
  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups
  • You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
  • Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass
  • Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens
  • Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the Team

We are building a new Enterprise Payments team – a dedicated motion focused on winning and expanding large enterprise customers around Airwallex’s payment acceptance solutions.

This is a greenfield opportunity: you will be among the first Enterprise hires in the Enterprise team, helping define the sales playbook, shape GTM strategy, and close the deals that put Airwallex on the map in the enterprise payment acceptance category.

What You’ll Do

New Business & Pipeline Generation

  • Own end-to-end enterprise sales cycles from prospecting through to contract signature, with deal sizes typically $250K+ ARR

  • Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of enterprise prospects through outbound prospecting, partner referrals, field events, and industry networks

  • Conduct white space analysis and account planning to prioritise highest-potential opportunities within your territory

  • Run structured, consultative sales processes: discovery, value proposition design, stakeholder mapping, commercial negotiation, and close

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Engage and build trust with multiple senior stakeholders – CFO, CPO, Head of Finance, IT and Procurement – across complex buying committees

  • Deliver compelling executive-level presentations and business cases that connect Airwallex’s payment acceptance capabilities to specific customer outcomes

  • Represent Airwallex at industry events, conferences, and customer roundtables to build brand presence in the enterprise payment acceptance market

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering and Product to run proof-of-concepts and tailored demos that showcase platform value

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Enterprise Payments product team to relay customer insights and influence roadmap priorities

  • Collaborate with Marketing on territory demand generation, ABM campaigns, and competitive positioning

  • Coordinate with Implementation post-close to ensure a seamless handover and strong early adoption

  • Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene – accurate pipeline data, forecasting, and activity logging in Salesforce

Market & Competitive Intelligence

  • Develop deep expertise in enterprise payment acceptance, card acquiring, payment service providers, payment orchestration, fraud prevention, and checkout optimisation to credibly position Airwallex against competition

  • Stay current on market trends, customer procurement patterns, and the competitive landscape to sharpen your sales approach

  • Contribute to the development of the Enterprise Payments GTM playbook — messaging, objection handling, competitive battlecards

Who You Are

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of total experience, including 3+ years in enterprise sales (hunting/new business) at a payments or fintech company.

  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding quota on complex enterprise deals ($250K+ ARR) with long sales cycles.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage full commercial cycles: prospecting, multi-stakeholder discovery, value selling, and negotiating legal/procurement terms.

  • Fluent in English and native-level proficiency in German.

  • Adaptable, results-driven mindset with a track record of thriving in high-growth, fast-paced environments.

  • English and German communication: Communicate with clarity and credibility in both English (fluent) and German (native).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep domain expertise in payment acceptance, card acquiring, PSPs, payment orchestration, or adjacent enterprise SaaS.

  • Foundational understanding of accounting and complex financial flows.

  • Strong executive-level presentation skills with experience multi-threading across CFOs, Heads of Product, and Procurement.

  • Proven ability to create structure and navigate ambiguous, early-stage enterprise sales environments.

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.description:
View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/...

 

***

 

THE KEY BITS

 

  • Location: We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK.

  • Flexibility: We operate a choice-first work approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near our London office hub.

  • Salary: We benchmarked £90,000 + equity at IC4 level in our progression framework for someone based in the UK. If you like the look of the role but the salary doesn’t match what you’re looking for, let us know in the application.

  • Interviews: 3 stages totalling around 3 hours over 2-3 weeks. See FAQ for detail.

  • Start date: As soon as you can start.

  • Reporting to: Keith Reid, Head of Product

  • More info: The FAQ below, juro.com/careers, our handbook or ask ----- anything.

 
 

HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

 

Signing a contract is the easy part. Everything before it (multiple parties, several legal documents, opposing interests, a redlining process most companies still run through email attachments) is where contracting actually gets hard.

That's the part of Juro you'll own. It's the most ambitious area of the product and the one with the most room to change how contracting feels for the people doing it day to day.

We're not handing you a blank page. There's a roadmap in place and a team ready to build it. We want you shipping against it while you're forming your own view of the problem, then tell us which parts of it were wrong.

Every PM at Juro is hired to make product bets that pay out. Great means that:

  1. the bets you own deliver real outcomes for customers quickly, and

  2. those outcomes show up in revenue.

What you're here to do:

  • Ship against the contract workflow roadmap in your first few weeks.

  • Get close to the problem rapidly. Talk to customers and prospects yourself. Form your own view of the jobs to be done rather than inheriting ours.

  • Take on AI review. It's a deep agentic system (evals, flows, failure modes) and "good redline" isn't a pass/fail, which is what makes it hard. It also spans your team and our Agentic team, so some of what you own won't sit neatly in one place.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with engineering, design and GTM to turn all of that into something people actually enjoy using.

  • Measure whether any of it worked and be honest when it didn't. Iterate or pivot when necessary.

Six months in, success looks like customers telling us unprompted that contracting in Juro got a lot more delightful and reaching for it in places they used to reach for Word.

 

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

 
 

WHO WE LOOK FOR

 

Research shows that while men apply to jobs if they meet ~60% of criteria, women and those in traditionally under-represented groups tend to apply only if they check all boxes. So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

 

To succeed here:

Every Juror finds their balance across our four core principles — we hire, develop and celebrate people who live them every day.

Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

  • You've landed in a domain you knew nothing about and were making judgment calls within weeks. Ideally more than once.

  • You've owned something complex and multi-quarter from discovery through launch and iteration + were accountable when it slipped.

  • You've worked shoulder to shoulder with GTM and engineering through launches + have been the trusted go-to person for them in past companies.

  • You understand why evals matter and how agentic loops work.*

  • You run your own discovery. Customer calls, prospect calls, synthesising messy qualitative input into a clear view of what to build.

  • You've brought ideas unprompted and built them without waiting for permission. Something small shipped in days beats a perfect spec written in weeks.

  • BONUS #1: You've owned the quality of an agentic system in production.

  • BONUS #2: Legal tech or contracting experience.

*What we care about is that you will dig into how a system actually behaves when you need to: work out why a flow is producing rubbish, go back and forth with engineers until it isn't. You don't need to have done this full time.

This job likely isn’t for you if:

  • You need someone to teach you the domain before you can be useful.

  • You think of AI as something the engineers deal with.

  • You want a settled team and a clean remit. Our product org will change, and some of your scope will cut across other teams.

  • You'd want to spend your first quarter rewriting the roadmap before shipping any of it.

  • You'd rather run the process than talk to customers.

  • You've been managing PMs and want to carry on doing that. This is hands-on.

 
 

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

Frustrated by the absurdly slow process of taking a contract from inception through to agreement, Juro co-founders Richard and Pavel thought there must be a better way. They set out in 2016 to build a flexible, collaborative platform that anyone could use to process a legal contract end-to-end in their browser.

Fast forward 8 years and we have helped our customers process 2 million contracts in over 85 countries. Some of the world’s fastest-growing businesses, like Deliveroo, Remote, and Trustpilot have relied on Juro to help them streamline routine contracts at scale across multiple years of their growth.

But our story is just beginning.‍ Read more about our vision for intelligent contract automation.

About this role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join one of our stream-aligned engineering teams. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets.

In this role

  • Deliver high quality features both individually and with other team members, working full-stack across whatever the stream requires.

What you will need

  • 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.

  • Experience with strongly typed languages (i.e., Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our tech stack quickly.

  • Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow, and curious about how AI can improve how we build.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and understanding of secure development principles to building safe, trusted systems

  • Fluency in English is a must.

What we offer

  • Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.

  • Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.

  • Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.

  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

  • Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.

  • We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!
